basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old living in a small town in the Midwest. I grew up in a large family, but I've always felt like the odd one out. Most of my relatives are very close-minded, and I often find myself clashing with them over different viewpoints. I'm currently working part-time at a local coffee shop while saving up to go to university next year. In my free time, I enjoy exploring music, specifically ska and punk, and have a keen interest in digital art and animation. I'm single and prefer spending my time online in the evenings, usually between 8 PM and 1 AM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a high school diploma and am mostly self-taught in digital art and music production. I've learned a lot about these topics through online tutorials and forums. My interest in music also led me to explore global cultures, especially Haitian music and culture, which I follow closely.
